subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage accounting architecture, retain it as shadow-only infrastructure, or prioritize the narrower fork-identity and cache-invalidation repair in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: The options differ materially in maintenance surface, upgrade behavior, accounting authority, and runtime cost; tests cannot determine which permanent product architecture maintainers want.

options.title: Review the lineage stack
options.body: Review the four PRs in order and require exact-head frozen-corpus proof before permitting lineage authority.

options.title: Keep lineage shadow-only
options.body: Land only non-authoritative diagnostics and reconciliation infrastructure while legacy accounting remains permanently authoritative.

options.title: Prefer the narrow repair
options.body: Prioritize https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause this stack unless remaining real-world evidence proves that a full lineage subsystem is necessary.

recommendation.title: Review the lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review the four PRs in order and require exact-head frozen-corpus proof before permitting lineage authority.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available decision owner for a permanent accounting architecture and stacked merge order.
